description: This file contains documentation for functions of the DateTimePicker widget from the eonasdan-bootstrap-datetimepicker library. It describes various methods like destroy(), toggle(), show(), hide(), disable(), enable(), clear(), and viewDate(), including their behaviors and emitted events.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the widget and removes all attached event listeners

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Shows or hides the widget and emits related events

methods.name: show
methods.description: Shows the widget and emits related events

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the widget and emits related events

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the input element, hides the widget if visible, and emits events

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the input element by removing the disabled attribute

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the datepicker by setting its value to null

methods.name: viewDate
methods.description: Gets or sets the current view date of the date picker, compatible with string, moment, or Date

search-terms: destroy toggle show hide disable enable clear viewDate
